item.title: ui: use a red edge on the send button's error state (#32856)
item.description:
<pre style='white-space:pre-wrap;width:81ex'>ui: use a red edge on the send button's error state (#32856)
The error state reused the primary button's edge, which shows as a light ring in dark mode. Use the danger button's edge | why kept: claude
